name: Ultrafast Spatial Texture-Atlas Splatting
definition: A learned sparse scene representation based on 2D surfels that bakes the neural component into a hardware-accelerated 2D texture atlas to eliminate runtime network inference.
summary: Ultrafast Spatial Texture-Atlas Splatting is a learned sparse scene representation that achieves 7–9× faster rendering than 3D Gaussian Splatting by baking view-independent appearance into a hardware-accelerated 2D texture atlas.
